use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use RGB = (red: ubyte, green: ubyte, blue: ubyte)

pt(x: double, y: double) -> (x: double, y: double) => (x = x, y = y)

scene() -> IMAGE is
    let image = IMAGE(160, 120)

    for y in 0..80 do
        let t = cast double(y) / 80.0D

        image.colour(
            cast ubyte(40.0D + 200.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(70.0D + 100.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(160.0D - 60.0D * t))
        image.fill_rectangle(
            0.0D, cast double(y), 160.0D, cast double(y + 1))
    od

    image.colour(255ub, 220ub, 60ub)
    image.disc(112.0D, 42.0D, 15.0D)

    image.colour(90ub, 60ub, 120ub)
    image.fill([pt(0.0D, 80.0D), pt(45.0D, 30.0D), pt(95.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(60ub, 110ub, 70ub)
    image.fill([pt(55.0D, 80.0D), pt(105.0D, 48.0D), pt(160.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(70ub, 150ub, 60ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(0.0D, 80.0D, 160.0D, 120.0D)

    image.colour(200ub, 35ub, 40ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(22.0D, 88.0D, 52.0D, 110.0D)

    image.colour(120ub, 25ub, 30ub)
    image.fill([pt(18.0D, 88.0D), pt(37.0D, 75.0D), pt(56.0D, 88.0D)])

    image.colour(250ub, 245ub, 235ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(33.0D, 97.0D, 41.0D, 110.0D)

    image
si

lerp(a: double, b: double, t: double) -> double => a + (b - a) * t

bilinear(source: IMAGE, x: double, y: double) -> (double, double, double) is
    let x0 = Math.min(cast int(Math.floor(x)), source.width - 1)
    let y0 = Math.min(cast int(Math.floor(y)), source.height - 1)
    let x1 = Math.min(x0 + 1, source.width - 1)
    let y1 = Math.min(y0 + 1, source.height - 1)
    let tx = x - cast double(x0), ty = y - cast double(y0)

    let a = source.pixel(x0, y0), b = source.pixel(x1, y0)
    let c = source.pixel(x0, y1), d = source.pixel(x1, y1)

    mix(pick: RGB -> ubyte) -> double =>
        lerp(
            lerp(cast double(pick(a)), cast double(pick(b)), tx),
            lerp(cast double(pick(c)), cast double(pick(d)), tx),
            ty)

    (mix(p => p.red), mix(p => p.green), mix(p => p.blue))
si

enlarge(source: IMAGE, factor: double) -> IMAGE is
    let width = cast int(Math.round(cast double(source.width) * factor))
    let height = cast int(Math.round(cast double(source.height) * factor))
    let result = IMAGE(width, height)
    let across = cast double(source.width - 1) / cast double(width - 1)
    let down = cast double(source.height - 1) / cast double(height - 1)

    for y in 0..height do
        for x in 0..width do
            let sx = cast double(x) * across
            let sy = cast double(y) * down
            let (r, g, b) = bilinear(source, sx, sy)

            result.set_pixel(
                x, y,
                cast ubyte(Math.round(r)),
                cast ubyte(Math.round(g)),
                cast ubyte(Math.round(b)))
        od
    od

    result
si

scene().write("scene.png")

let source = IMAGE.read("scene.png")
let larger = enlarge(source, 1.6D)

write_line("{source.width} x {source.height} enlarged by 60%")
write_line("to {larger.width} x {larger.height}")

source.show("scene.png")

larger.write("larger.png")

larger.show("larger.png")
